title: Ben jumping on scooter woth motion blur in wrong direction
summary: Son needed a photo for project. Took one and printed it out. Thought I would suprise him and blur out background. Don't use my normal Gaussian filter. Try this motion thing. Show Ben he takes one look, "why is the motion blurred the wrong way?" The original print made his final copy.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
